description: Horizontal datum test of one delivery: residual shift to 3DEP under both readings of the WGS84 label, at several sample areas. An informative sample votes for the reading with the clearly smaller residual (by data_src.datum.min_margin_m) when that residual is below max_winner_share of the distance between the readings; the decision is the reading that gets every vote (at least min_votes), otherwise ambiguous.

decision.description: ambiguous stops the pipeline for this delivery

winner.description: Reading with the clearly smaller residual shift; null if not informative or too close

informative.description: Under both hypotheses the NMAD minimum is sharp (sharpness >= data_src.datum.min_sharpness); flat cells cannot locate a shift and do not count

dx_m.description: Residual east shift 2011 -> 3DEP after this hypothesis's transform

passes.description: Diagnostic: hypot(dx_m, dy_m) < max_residual_m (a larger residual under the winning reading points to a line-level horizontal error)

sharpness.description: Smallest relative NMAD rise data_src.datum.probe_m away from the best shift in x or y
